---
title: "IOTC ROS Data Reporting: Form ROS-LL"
---

# Description

This form describes the reporting of operational and catch data collected by scientific observers at sea, or from data reviewed through Electronic Monitoring Systems, for longline fisheries under the IOTC Regional Observer Scheme (ROS). It is designed to capture verified information on fishing activities, catch composition, bycatch associated with longline operations, and the implementation of mitigation measures. The reporting format follows standards adopted by the IOTC Scientific Committee (SC) and incorporates multiple hierarchical data levels, ranging from trip and set information to species-specific catch and bycatch records.

Click [here](./Form-ROS-LL.xlsx) to download a blank version of Form ROS-LL, or [return](../index.html) to the list of all IOTC data reporting forms.

# Data Content

Form ROS-LL is an XLSX workbook comprising 19 sheets, designed to report the mandatory (<span style="color: blue;">M; blue cells</span>) and optional (<span style="color: green;">O; green cells</span>) data fields defined by the SC. The current version builds on the most recent revision of ROS fields endorsed at the 27^th^ session of the SC ([IOTC-2024-SC27-DATA01](https://iotc.org/documents/SC/27/DATA01)). The sheets are interconnected through technical identifiers (observer trip ID, set ID), enabling the hierarchical organisation of the observations to be maintained.

| Sheet | Data Components | Resolution |  Description |
| :------------- | :----------: | :--------: | :--------------------------- |
| [META](#meta) |    Metadata | Trip | Information on the data submission by reporting fleet |
| [O-INFO](#oInfo) | Metadata | Trip | Observer identification and information of the observed fishing trip |
| [V-INFO](#vInfo) | Metadata | Trip | Identification of the fishing vessel and personnel information |
| [V-TRIP](#vTrip) | Metadata | Trip | Information on the fishing trip’s course |
| [V-ATTRIBUTES](#vAttributes) | Technology / Equipment | Trip | Information on the vessel’s attributes and equipment |
| [G-GENERAL](#gGeneral) | Gear configuration | Trip | Information on the fishing gear’s equipment and machinery | 
| [G-CONFIG-BRANCHLINES](#gConfigBranchlines) | Gear configuration | Trip | Information on longline branchline configurations |
| [G-CONFIG-MITIGATION-DEVICES](#gConfigMitigationDevices) | Gear configuration | Trip | Information on mitigation devices | 
| [E-SET](#eSet) | Gear Technology / Equipment | Operation | Information on setting by operations |
| [E-SET-LIGHTS](#eSetLights) | Gear Technology / Equipment | Operation | Information on the lights used for fish attraction |
| [E-SET_MITIGATION_MEASURES](#eSetMitigationMeasures) | Gear Technology / Equipment | Operation | Information on  configuration of mitigation devices |
| [E-SET-HOOKS](#eSetHooks) | Gear Technology / Equipment | Operation | Information on fishing hooks by operation |
| [E-SET-BAITS](#eSetBaits) | Gear Technology / Equipment | Operation | Information on fishing bait use by operation |
| [E-SET-HAULING](#eSetHauling) | Gear Technology / Equipment | Operation | Hauling  information by operation | 
| [E-SET-HAULING-BITEOFFS](#eSetHaulingBiteoffs) | Catch | Operation | Information on depredation events recorded during hauling |
| [E-SET-CATCHES](#eSetCatches) | Catch | Operation | Information on magnitude, composition, and fate of catch |
| [E-SET-CATCH-SPECIMENS](#eSetCatchSpecimens) | Catch | Species| Information on fish biology (size, sex, maturity), samples, and depredation |
| [E-SET-CATCH-SPECIMENS-SSI](#eSetCatchSpecimensSSI) | Catch | Species | Information Species of Special Interest (SSI) caught in the observed trip |
| [E-SET-TAG-DETAILS](#eSetTagDetails) | Catch | Species | Information on tag release or recovery by specimen |

# META {#meta}

## Submission Information

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| Liaison officer full name | M | Name of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | String | `John Doe`  |
| Liaison officer email | M | Email address of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | `John.Doe@fao.org` |
| Organisation name | M | Name of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | String | `Institute of Fisheries` |
| Organisation email | O | Email address of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | `nif@gov.sc` |
| Finalisation date | M | Date of finalisation of the dataset | String based on [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | `1996-03-27` |
| [Submission date] | M | Date of submission of the dataset | String based on [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | `1997-03-21` |

## General Information

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| Reporting year | M | Gregorian calendar year of the fishing activities reported through the dataset | 4-digit integer | `1996` |
| Reporting entity | M | Three-letter (alpha-3) code of the entity reporting the dataset to the IOTC Secretariat | **Code** from [Entities](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#entities) | `ABW` |
| Flag / Chartering state | M | The country registration of the fishing vessels or chartering flag in case of chartering agreement | **Code** from [Countries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#countries) | `FRA` |
| Data source | M | The source of the data, i.e., collected by observers at sea or derived from Electronic Monitoring Systems | **Code** from [Data Sources](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#sourcesRO) | `OB` |

# O-INFO {#oInfo}

This section of the form includes information about the observer and an overview of the fishing trip they observed.

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| observed_trip_id | M | The unique identifier for the observed trip. For instance, the identifier could be defined as the concatenation of (i) the observation or trip start date (YYYY-MM-DD), (ii) the IOTC observer identifier, (iii) the IOTC vessel identifier as per Record of Authorised Vessels ([RAV](https://rav.iotc.org/)) and the vessel [gear group](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#gearGroups) code as per IOTC classification | Alphanumeric | `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/LL` |

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|

## Observed Trip Details

| **Embarkation:** The starting port. If the first observation is available after the departure from the port while the vessel is within port limits, this is still recorded as the observation starting port. If the observation starts at sea outside port limits (onboard observer boarding the vessel via a vessel transfer or EM records not available at the trip starting date due to a recording failure), record "at sea".

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **In port**
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| country | O | The country or EEZ of the observation starting location | **Code** from [Countries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#countries) | `FRA` |
| port | O | The port of the observation starting location | **Code** from [Ports](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#ports) | `REUREU` |
:::

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **At sea**
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| latitude  | O | The latitude of the observation starting location, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | Float based on [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DD.DDDD] | `-20.8854` |
| longitude | O | The longitude of the observation starting location, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | Float based on [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DDD.DDDD] | `55.5312` |
:::

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
||||||
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| date_time_utc | O | The date and time of the start of observations in Coordinated Universal Time ([UTC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time)) | String based on [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |
:::

| **Disembarkation:** The ending port. If the last observation is available after a port launch while the vessel is within port limits, this is still recorded as the observation ending port. If the observation ends at sea outside port limits (onboard observer disembarking the vessel via a vessel transfer or EM records not available at the end of observations due to a recording failure), record "at sea"
|

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **In port**
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| country | O | The country or EEZ of the observation ending location | **Code** from [Countries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#countries) | `FRA` |
| port | O | The port of the observation ending location | **Code** from [Ports](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#ports) | `REUREU` |
:::

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **At sea**
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| latitude | O | The latitude of the observation ending location, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | Float based on [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DD.DDDD] | `-20.8854` |
| longitude | O | The longitude of the observation ending location, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | Float based on [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DDD.DDDD] | `55.5312` |
:::

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
|  |  |  |  |  |

## Observed Trip Summary

| **Number of fishing sets:** The total number of longline sets deployed by the vessel or observed by the scientific observer during a single fishing trip. Each set corresponds to one complete deployment of the longline gear.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| conducted | M | The total number of fishing sets conducted by the vessel from the observation starting date to the observation ending date, regardless their catch and data collection activities | Integer | `20` |
| observed | M | The total number of fishing sets monitored by the observer. In the case of Electronic Monitoring, only processed sets to be included | Integer | `17` |
:::

| **Number of days:** The total number of calendar days the vessel is on a fishing trip, with each day defined as a 24-hour period. These days can be further categorised by activity type (e.g. searching, transiting, actively fishing, or present in fishing areas).

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| searching | O | The number of days searching during the observation period | Integer | `31.2` |
| actively_fishing | O | The number of active fishing days during the observation period | Integer | `43.1` |
| in_fishing_area | O | The number of days in the fishing area during the observation period | Integer | `45.8` |
| transiting | O | The number of days transiting during the observation period | Integer | `5.0` |
| lost | O | The number of days lost during the observation period | Integer | `1.1` |
:::

| **Reasons for lost days:** The reason(s) a vessel was unable to fish: (i) adverse weather conditions, (ii) mechanical breakdown or inoperative gear or (iii) unforeseen events (specify).

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| reason | O | The main reasons for days at sea lost to fishing activity. Up to 4 reasons may be reported on the form | **Code** from [Reasons for Days Lost](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#reasonsDaysLost) | `AW` |
:::

| **Identification:** Unique identifiers and key details of the vessel to uniquely identify the vessel in fisheries and observer records.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|

| port | O | The vessel's port of registry (also called home port) shown on its registration documents and lettered on the stern of the ship's hull | **Code** from [Ports](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#ports) | `REUREU` |
| registration_number | O | The number issued by country in which the vessel is registered, shown on its registration documents and written on the hull of the vessel | Alphanumeric or numeric entry according to CPC standards | `CBG303` |
:::

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| licensed_target_species | O | The licensed target species as specified in vessel licences or permit conditions | **Code** from [Target Species](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#targetSpecies) | `AL` |
| main_fishing_gear | M | The vessel main fishing gear | **Code** from [Gear](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#gears) | `DL` |

| **Vessel Personnel:** Details of the individuals working onboard during the fishing trip as well as the total number of crew members onboard.

| fishing_master_nationality | M | The nationality of the fishing master | **Code** from [Countries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#countries) | `FRA` |
| skipper_captain_name | M | Name of the skipper or captain recorded as first and last names| String | `John Doe` |
| skipper_captain_nationality | M | Nationality of the skipper or captain | **Code** from [Countries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#countries) | `FRA` |

## Trip Details

| **Vessel departure:** The name and/or geographical coordinates of the port from where the vessel sailed – also include the country. If the vessel started a new trip at sea following transshipment record 'at-sea’ plus the geographical coordinates corresponding to the location the trip started.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **In port**
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| country | O | The country or EEZ from which the trip started | **Code** from [Countries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#countries) | `FRA` |
| port | O | The port from which the trip started | **Code** from [Ports](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#ports) | `REUREU` |
| latitude | O | The latitude from which the trip started, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | Float based on [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DD.DDDD] | `-20.8854` |
| longitude | O | The longitude from which the trip started, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | Float based on [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DDD.DDDD] | `55.5312` |
:::

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
||||||
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| date_time_utc | O | The date and time corresponding to the start of the vessel trip at the reported location in Coordinated Universal Time ([UTC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time)) | String based on [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |
:::

| **Vessel return:** The name and/or geographical coordinates of the port where the vessel returned – also include the country. If the vessel arrived at a transshipment location record 'at-sea' plus the geographical coordinates corresponding to the location the transshipment started. If the observer disembarked before the vessel returned then record expected port of return as provided by the vessel.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **In port**
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| country | O | The country or EEZ from which the trip ends | **Code** from [Countries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#countries) | `FRA` |
| port | O | The port from which the trip ends | **Code** from [Ports](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#ports) | `REUREU` |
| latitude | O | The latitude from which the trip ends, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | Float based on [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DD.DDDD] | `-20.8854` |
| longitude | O | The longitude from which the trip ends, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | Float based on [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DDD.DDDD] | `55.5312` |
:::

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
|               |     |     |                  |                        |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| date_time_utc | O | The date and time corresponding to the end of the vessel trip at the reported location in Coordinated Universal Time ([UTC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time)) | String based on [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |

## Vessel Electronics

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| gnss | O | Indicates whether or not one or more Global Navigation Satellite System systems (GNSS) such as the US Global Positioning System (GPS) were present on the vessel | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `TRUE` |
| vms | O | Indicates whether or not one or more Vessel Monitoring Systems (VMS) were present on the vessel | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `TRUE` |
| ais | O | Indicates whether or not one or more Automatic Identification Systems (AIS) were present on the vessel | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `TRUE` |
| radars | O | Indicates whether or not one or more radars were present on the vessel | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `TRUE`  |
| track_plotter | O | Indicates whether or not one or more track plotters were present on the vessel | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `TRUE` |
| depth_sounder | O | Indicates whether or not one or more depth sounders were present on the vessel | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `TRUE` |
| sonar | O | Indicates whether one or more sonars were present on the vessel | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `TRUE` |
| doppler_current_meter | O | Indicates whether one or more doppler current meters were present on the vessel | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `FALSE` |

# G-CONFIG-MITIGATION-DEVICES {#gConfigMitigationDevices}

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |

| observed_trip_id | M | The parent observed trip identifier | Alphanumeric | `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/LL` |

## Tori Line Details

A tori line is a mitigation device used in longline fisheries to reduce seabird bycatch. It is a streamer line towed from a high point at the stern of the vessel during line setting. The device consists of a main line with brightly coloured streamers attached at intervals, which flutter in the wind and touch the water surface, creating a visual barrier that deters seabirds from approaching and taking baited hooks as they sink.

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| tori_line_length | M | The total length (m) of the tori line, excluding streamers | Float | `150` |
| streamer_type | M | The type of streamers which are used with the tori line | **Code** from [Streamer Types](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#streamerTypes) | `MU` |
| reach_surface | O | Indicates whether or not the streamers are long enough to touch the surface of the water in calm conditions | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `FALSE` |
| streamer_line_length_max_m | M | The value of the maximum length (m) of individual streamer lines | Float |`10` |
| streamer_line_length_min_m | O | The value of the minimum length (m) of individual streamer lines | Float | `1` |
| streamer_number_per_line | M | The number of streamers that are attached to a single tori line | Integer | `20` |
| distance_between_streamers_m | O | The distance (m) between streamers | Float | `5` |
| tori_line_attached_height_m | M | The height that the tori line is attached above the water level | Float | `8` |
| towed_objects_type | O | The type of object used to maintain tori line tension and to achieve aerial extent when deployed | `tbd` | `tbd` |
| towed_objects_number | O | Number of objects used to maintain tori line tension and to achieve aerial extent when deployed | Integer | Integer | `tbd` |

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| species | M | The species of the portion of catch of interest | **Code** from [All Species](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/#allSpecies) | `ABL` |

| **Fate**: The fate which includes whether it was retained or discarded and the reason.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| fate_type | M | The outcome of the catch, indicating whether a fish was retained on board or discarded | **Code** from [Types of Fate](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#fateTypes) | `DI` |
| fate | M | The final disposition of the catch or sampled portion of the catch, indicating whether it was retained on board or discarded, with specification of the reason where applicable | **Code** from [Fates](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#fates) | `DL` |
:::

||||||
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| sampling_method | M | The method applied to derive the total catch from the samples collected during observation | **Code** from [Sampling Methods for Catch Estimation](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#samplingMethodsForCatchEstimation) | `EP` |
| number_of_fish | M | The numbers of individuals observed/caught by species and fate (including if recording at an individual animal level) | Integer | `7` |

| **Weight:** The catch weight corresponding to the specified species and product type recorded in processing type. If the fish has not been processed, it corresponds to the unprocessed weight.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| processing_type | O | Form in which the fish is processed prior to storage | **Code** from [Fish Processing Types](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#fishProcessingTypes) | `DR` |
| value_kg | O | The value of fish weight expressed in kilograms (kg) | Float | `153` |
| estimation_method | O | The method applied to derive the weight from the samples collected during observation | **Code** from [Sampling Methods for Catch Estimation](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#samplingMethodsForCatchEstimation) | `EP` |
:::

# E-SET-CATCH-SPECIMENS {#eSetCatchSpecimens}

This section of the form is for the recording of biological information of the specimens sampled during individual sets.

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| observed_trip_id | M | The parent observed trip identifier | Alphanumeric | `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/LL` |
| set_id | M | The parent set identifier | Alphanumeric | `0003` |
| catch_id | M | The parent species-specific catch component identifier | Alphanumeric  | `C188` |
| specimen_id | M | The unique identifier for each individual specimen sampled or measured within a species-specific catch component, a four-digit numerical code assigned consecutively, beginning with 0001 | Alphanumeric | `0005` |

## Specimen Details

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| sampling_period | M | Stage period when the specimen was sampled | **Code** from [Sampling Period](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#samplingPeriods) | `BS` |
| sampling_method | M | The sampling method used for the collection of biological sub-sample(s) | **Code** from [Biological Sampling Method](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#samplingMethodsForSamplingCollections) | `ES` |

| **Length:** The specimen's individual length corresponding to the specified length type. Up to two length measurements may be reported on the form.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| length_type | M | The type of length used for the measurement | **Code** from [Length Measurements](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#lengthMeasurements) | `CF` |
| length_value_cm | M | The value of length corresponding to the length type taken rounded to the lower centimetre | Float | `34` |
| length_measuring_tool | M | The tool used for the measurement of the fish length | **Code** from [Length Measurement Tools](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#lengthMeasurementTools) | `CA` |
:::

| **Weight**: The specimen's individual weight corresponding to the specified specie and product type. Unprocessed weight when the fish has not been processed.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| weight_processing_type | O | The processing/dressing used for the weight measurement | **Code** from [Weight Measurements](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#weightMeasurements)  | `GG` |
| weight_value_kg | O | The weight corresponding to the weight measurement type code | Float | `43.2` |
| weight_estimation_method | O | The method used to estimate the weight of the specimen | **Code** from [Weight Measurement Tools](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#weightMeasurementTools) | `BR` |
:::

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| sex | O | The sex of the sampled fish specimen | **Code** from [Sex](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#sex) | `F` |

| **Maturity:** The stage of maturity of the specimen according to standard maturity scales approved by the IOTC.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| maturity_scale | O | The standardised system used to classify the reproductive development of fish (i.e., source) | String | `ICCAT` |
| maturity_stage | O | The reproductive stage of a fish determined through visual inspection of the gonads without the aid of a microscope | **Code** from [Maturity Stages](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#maturityStages) | `DEV` | 
:::

| **Sample collected:** Details on the collection of samples: a) type (otoliths, spine clippings, and genetic samples), b) preservation method (alcohol, frozen, etc.), c) destination (i.e., location to be sent/stored)

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| sample_type | O | The type of sample collected by the observer | **Code** from [Sampling Type](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#samplingMethodsForSamplingCollections) | `WM`|
| sample_preservation_method | O | The type of preservation method used to preserve the sample collected by the observer | **Code** from [Sample Preservation Method](#fishPreservationMethods) | `FR20` |
| sample_destination | O | Destination of the collected sample after the trip (institution or lab of analysis) | Free entry | `University of Tasmania` |
:::

| **Depredation method:** The method by which depredation occurs, based on evidence observed during the fishing operation.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| depredation_source | O | The depredation source based on depredation scar characteristics | **Code** from [Depredation Sources](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#depredationSources) | `BA` |
| observed_predator | O | The predator species when directly observed and identified | **Code** from [Predator Species](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#depredationSources#speciesPredators) | `AG15` |
:::

# E-SET-CATCH-SPECIMENS-SSI {#eSetCatchSpecimensSSI}

This section of the form includes information about Species of Special Interest ([SSI](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/#SSIspecies)) sampled in selected sets.

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| observed_trip_id | M | The parent observed trip identifier | Alphanumeric | `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/LL` |
| set_id | M | The parent set identifier | Alphanumeric | `0004` |
| catch_id | M | The parent species-specific catch component identifier | Alphanumeric  | `0004#1` |
| specimen_id | M | The parent specimen identifier | Alphanumeric | `01` |

## Additional Catch Details on SSI

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| condition_at_capture | M | The condition of the specimen at capture | **Code** from [Individual Conditions](#individualConditions) | `A0` |
| condition_at_release | M | The condition of the specimen at the time of release | **Code** from [Individual Conditions](#individualConditions) | `A0` |
| gear_interaction | M | The type of interaction of the specimen with the fishing gear ("UK" if unknown as not possible to collect) | **Code** from [Gear Interactions](#gearInteractions) | `EF` |
| hook_type | O | The type of hook the individual was hauled on | **Code** [Hook Types](#hookTypes) from | `C11` |

| **Bait:** The type and condition of the bait the individual was hauled on 

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| bait_condition | O | Physical condition or preparation of the bait used during fishing | **Code** from [Bait Conditions](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#baitConditions) | `DE` |
| bait_type | O | Type of bait used during fishing | **Code** from [Bait Types](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#baitTypes) | `FF` | 
:::

| **Leader**
::: {style="margin-left:40px"}

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| material | M | The leader material the SSI individual was hauled on | **Code** from [Line Material Types](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#lineMaterialTypes)| `MN` |
| diameter | O | The thickness (mm) of the leader the SSI individual was hauled on | Float | `tbd` |
:::

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| dehooker_device | O | The dehooking or line cutting device used to extract the hook | **Code** [Dehooker Types](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#dehookerTypes) from | HD  |
| brought_onboard | O | Indicates whether or not the specimen was brought onboard | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `FALSE` |
| handling_method | O | Detail how the specimen was brought onboard | **Code** from [Handling Methods](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#handlingMethods) | `AN` |
| revival | O | Indicates whether or not the release took place with resuscitation for turtles | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `NAPP`  |
| photo_id | O | The unique identifier of the photo taken of a specimen | Alphanumeric | `Doe_Hawwa_20260302_1435_hawksbill.png` |

# E-SET-TAG-DETAILS {#eSetTagDetails}

This section of the form is for the reporting of each of the tags recovered during the observed portion of the fishing trip.

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| observed_trip_id | M | The parent observed trip identifier | Alphanumeric | `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/LL` | 
| set_id | M | The parent set identifier | Alphanumeric | `0023` |
| catch_id | M | The parent species-specific catch component identifier | Alphanumeric | `0023#1` |
| specimen_id | M | The parent specimen identifier | Alphanumeric | `02` |

## Tag Details

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:------------------------|:---------:|:----------------:|
| release | O | Indicates whether or not the individual was re-released with a tag attached | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses) | `FALSE` |
| recovery | O | Indicates whether or not the individual was recovered with a tag attached | **Code** from [Logical Responses](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#logicalResponses)  | `TRUE`  |
| type | O | The type of tag used | **Code** from [Tag Types](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#tagTypes) | `CP` |
| tag_id | O | The tag identifier(s). Up to two identifier may be reported on the form | Alphanumeric | `AA19051` |
| finder_name | O | The full name of the person who found the tag, recorded as first and last names | String | `Jane Doe` |
| finder_contact_details | O | The contact details (address, email, telephone) of the person who found the tag | String | `jane.doe@fishing.org` |
